description:
You are a biomedical data engineer auditing VitalDB case #6 for a research database. Vital Recorder is open with this case loaded. Your task is to examine the Solar8000/PLETH_SPO2 track (pulse oximetry SpO2) across the entire recording and identify ALL episodes where the signal drops out (no data, flat-line at zero, or trace disappears).

Navigate through the full recording timeline carefully.

Create a structured report at C:\Users\Docker\Documents\dropout_report.txt with this exact format:

SIGNAL DROPOUT REPORT
=====================
Case: VitalDB #6
Track: Solar8000/PLETH_SPO2
Date of Audit: [today's date]

Total dropout episodes found: [N]

Episode 1:
  Start: [HH:MM:SS]
  End: [HH:MM:SS]
  Duration: [seconds]

[...for each episode...]

Total dropout time: [seconds]
Signal availability: [percentage]%

Times should be relative to recording start (00:00:00). Navigate through the ENTIRE recording - do not skip sections. Include every dropout episode lasting 10 seconds or longer.
